request.style: English, solemn female voice with celtic choir, bodhran, harp, fiddle, flute, low drone, dark and mournful mood, 70 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The sixth hour broke the light of day
Darkness wrapped the world in grey
He trusts in God to set him free
Let God rescue him if He will be

[Verse]
The rebels on the crosses near
Heaped their insults without fear
He said, "I am the Son of God"
They mocked the words they did not know

[Chorus]
Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me
A loud voice in the silent night
Why have you forsaken me

[Verse]
Some stood by and heard the cry
Said he calls for Elijah
One ran to bring a drink of sour wine
On a stick, held out in the dark

[Chorus]
Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me
A loud voice in the silent night
Why have you forsaken me

[Bridge]
Leave him alone, they said with spite
Let's see if Elijah saves his life
The ninth hour held the breath of earth
In the shadow of the cross

[Chorus]
Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani
My God, my God, why have you forsaken me
A loud voice in the silent night
Why have you forsaken me

[Outro]
Why have you forsaken me
My God, why have you forsaken me
